description: NHFLOW semi-implicit with deep-water breaking (A 550 5): the focused packet RP1 of Rapp & Melville (1990), coarse (750 cells x 8 layers, dx 0.04 m = L_c/50, dt 0.02 s, theta 1/2, A 510 11, A 520 2), reconstructed waves (B 92 51, waverecon.dat); the crest tracking of A 550 4 with the deep-water breakers of FNPF A 350 5 (breaker scales, b(S), duration, energy) and their energy-matched viscosity.
covers: nhflow_breaking::breaking_barthelemy (A 550 5: breaking_crest3d model 5 with the NHFLOW dissipation per unit viscosity)
breaking_crest3d::rays (vbd, kwd: the deep-water breakers in their own field)
